current_state.zh: OpenAI 第 18 天产品冲刺将 Decisions API 正式发布为 GA，把 Open Responses 跨模型 API 规范捐赠给 Linux 基金会的 Agentic AI 基金会，新增性能优化，Uber 将 ChatGPT Work 从 1000 人试点扩展至超过 30000 名员工，同时再次重置了速率限制。

updates.title_zh: OpenAI一周就更新GPT-6 Sol，性能逼近Astra
updates.title_en: OpenAI一周就更新GPT-6 Sol，性能逼近Astra
updates.what_changed_zh: GPT-6.1 Sol 已上线 API、Codex 和 ChatGPT Work，尚未进入普通 ChatGPT 对话；具体基准测试显示性能接近 Astra；缓存输入价格从每百万 Token 0.2 美元降至 0.1 美元；该模型在 GPT-6 Sol 发布仅一周后推出。
updates.what_changed_en: GPT-6.1 Sol has rolled out to API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work, not yet in regular ChatGPT chat; specific benchmarks show near-Astra performance; cached input price halved to $0.1 per million tokens; model released just a week after GPT-6 Sol.
updates.current_state_zh: OpenAI 发布了 GPT-6.1 Sol，定位为以约五分之一成本提供接近 Astra 的智能。该模型已上线 API、Codex 和 ChatGPT Work（尚未进入普通 ChatGPT 对话），API 标准价格不变（每百万输入 Token 2 美元、输出 10 美元），缓存输入降至 0.1 美元，基准测试显示其编程和 Computer Use 性能接近 Astra。
updates.current_state_en: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Sol, marketed as near-Astra intelligence at roughly a fifth of the cost. It has rolled out to API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work (not yet in regular ChatGPT chat), with API standard pricing unchanged ($2 input / $10 output per million tokens) and cached input reduced to $0.1, benchmarks showing near-Astra coding and Computer Use performance.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Sol just a week after GPT-6 Sol, delivering near-Astra coding and Computer Use performance at unchanged API pricing (and half the cached-input cost) with rollout to API, Codex and ChatGPT Work.
updates.detailed_summary_en: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Sol just a week after GPT-6 Sol, delivering near-Astra coding and Computer Use performance at unchanged API pricing (and half the cached-input cost) with rollout to API, Codex and ChatGPT Work.

updates.title_zh: 刚刚，GPT-6 Astra接上宇树G1，把厨房收拾了！
updates.title_en: 刚刚，GPT-6 Astra接上宇树G1，把厨房收拾了！
updates.what_changed_zh:
据媒体报道，新近发布的 GPT-6「Astra」模型接入宇树（Unitree）G1 人形机器人，通过把机器人技能当作可调用的工具，完成了一次厨房整理任务。该演示将各项机器人能力视为语言模型可以调用的工具，用以执行物理动作。

该演示体现了基于大模型的具身控制思路，即前沿模型通过与其调用软件时相同的工具调用接口来调度机器人的物理技能。

演示的任务是用宇树 G1 收拾厨房。目前该演示仅见于媒体报道，尚无独立的性能评测或成功率数据公布。
updates.what_changed_en: A newly reported GPT-6 'Astra' model was connected to a Unitree G1 humanoid robot and completed a kitchen cleanup task by invoking robot skills as tools.
updates.current_state_zh:
据媒体报道，新近发布的 GPT-6「Astra」模型接入宇树（Unitree）G1 人形机器人，通过把机器人技能当作可调用的工具，完成了一次厨房整理任务。该演示将各项机器人能力视为语言模型可以调用的工具，用以执行物理动作。

updates.detailed_summary_zh: A newly reported GPT-6 'Astra' model was connected to a Unitree G1 humanoid robot and completed a kitchen cleanup task by invoking robot skills as tools.
updates.detailed_summary_en: A newly reported GPT-6 'Astra' model was connected to a Unitree G1 humanoid robot and completed a kitchen cleanup task by invoking robot skills as tools.
updates.background_zh: GPT-6 Astra 是 OpenAI 开发的大语言模型。据维基百科，该模型于 2026 年 9 月 3 日先向获批用户开放，次日全面可用，相关报道强调其在计算机和浏览器中独立完成复杂任务的能力。宇树 G1 是宇树科技（Unitree Robotics）的人形机器人，官方介绍其结合力位混合控制与模仿学习、强化学习，可实现对物体的精细操作。具身智能（embodied AI）指通过传感器和模型在物理世界中学习并行动的系統。
updates.background_en: GPT-6 Astra is a large language model developed by OpenAI; according to Wikipedia it was initially released to approved users on September 3, 2026, with general availability the following day, and coverage highlighted its ability to carry out complex tasks on a computer and in a browser. The Unitree G1 is a humanoid robot from Unitree Robotics, which the company describes as combining force-position hybrid control with imitation and reinforcement learning for precise object manipulation. Embodied AI refers to systems that learn from and act in the physical world through sensors and models.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该演示没有直接涉及任何加密资产；潜在传导主要通过 AI 与机器人叙事情绪，影响 AI agent 及 DePIN／机器人相关代币板块的市场情绪，而非现金流或协议基本面。
updates.market_impact_en: No crypto asset is directly involved in this demonstration; any market transmission would run through sentiment toward AI-and-robotics narrative sectors, such as AI agent and DePIN/robotics-related tokens, rather than through cash flows or protocol fundamentals.

updates.title_zh: OpenAI 的新代理是对 Meta 的一次出击——但它能与免费产品竞争吗？
updates.title_en: OpenAI’s new agent is a shot at Meta — but can it compete with free?
updates.what_changed_zh: 在年度 DevDay 上，OpenAI 发布了 Dots，这是一款由 GPT-6 Astra 驱动的 AI 代理，定位为与 Meta 快速增长的 Muse 代理平台竞争。
updates.what_changed_en: At its annual DevDay, OpenAI announced Dots, a GPT-6 Astra-powered AI agent positioned to compete with Meta's fast-growing Muse agent platform.
updates.current_state_zh: 在年度 DevDay 上，OpenAI 发布了 Dots，这是一款由 GPT-6 Astra 驱动的 AI 代理，定位为与 Meta 快速增长的 Muse 代理平台竞争。
updates.current_state_en: At its annual DevDay, OpenAI announced Dots, a GPT-6 Astra-powered AI agent positioned to compete with Meta's fast-growing Muse agent platform.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: At its annual DevDay, OpenAI announced Dots, a GPT-6 Astra-powered AI agent positioned to compete with Meta's fast-growing Muse agent platform.
updates.detailed_summary_en: At its annual DevDay, OpenAI announced Dots, a GPT-6 Astra-powered AI agent positioned to compete with Meta's fast-growing Muse agent platform.
updates.background_zh: Meta于2026年9月8日发布Muse，将其定位为可执行长时间任务的个人AI agent，而非只做单轮问答的聊天机器人，并在Mac与移动端免费提供。OpenAI的GPT-6系列稍早问世，其中Astra于2026年9月4日公开发布。此次DevDay上推出Dots，使两个agent平台成为直接竞争对手。
updates.background_en: Meta announced Muse, its personal AI agent for long-running tasks beyond single-exchange chat, on September 8, 2026, and offers it free for Mac and mobile. OpenAI's GPT-6 family arrived shortly before, with Astra going public on September 4, 2026. The DevDay launch of Dots sets the two agent platforms up as direct competitors.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该消息与加密市场没有直接的产品关联，但头部实验室的agent发布会影响AI agent代币板块的叙事走向，这是最接近的市场暴露点。与Meta免费Muse的竞争叙事，也会波及围绕agent产品定价与分发方式的更广泛讨论，而去中心化agent项目常以这一议题作为自身定位依据。
updates.market_impact_en: There is no direct product link to crypto, but frontier-lab agent launches shape narrative flow in the AI-agent token segment, which is the nearest point of market exposure. The competitive framing against Meta's free Muse also feeds the broader debate over pricing and distribution for agent products, an argument decentralized-agent projects commonly use for positioning.

updates.title_zh: ChatGPT的“智能界面”更新让回答中充满图片、图表和按钮
updates.title_en: ChatGPT’s ‘Intelligent UI’ update fills its responses with pictures, charts, and buttons
updates.what_changed_zh: OpenAI 宣布 GPT-6 与智能界面（Intelligent UI）已在 Chat 标签页面向 ChatGPT Plus、Pro、Business 和 Enterprise 层级全球推送，Free 和 Go 层级次日跟进；该更新仅适用于 ChatGPT 聊天体验，Work 和 Codex 仍按各自独立路线推进。
updates.what_changed_en: OpenAI announced that GPT-6 with Intelligent UI began rolling out globally to ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise tiers in the Chat tab, with Free and Go tiers following the next day; the update applies to the ChatGPT chat experience while Work and Codex remain on separate tracks.
updates.current_state_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 及智能界面（Intelligent UI），目前正分阶段推送给 ChatGPT 用户：Plus、Pro、Business、Enterprise 已在 Chat 标签页获得更新，Free 和 Go 层级次日跟进；Work 和 Codex 暂不在此次推送范围内。
updates.current_state_en: OpenAI released GPT-6 with Intelligent UI and is rolling it out in stages to ChatGPT users: Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise tiers received it in the Chat tab, with Free and Go tiers following the next day; Work and Codex are not part of this rollout.
updates.detailed_summary_zh:
OpenAI正在ChatGPT中推出名为“智能界面”（Intelligent UI）的新功能，让助手在文字回答之外还能组合展示交互式示意图、图表、表单和可点击按钮。该功能与GPT-6一同发布，并称将覆盖所有用户。

这一变化改变了ChatGPT在整个平台上呈现回答的方式，使助手从纯文本输出转向针对具体任务的交互式结果，而不再只是用文字描述步骤。

据OpenAI公告，搭载智能界面的GPT-6率先在Chat标签页面向ChatGPT Plus、Pro、Business和Enterprise用户全球推送，次日扩展至Free和Go层级；该更新适用于ChatGPT的聊天体验，Work和Codex目前仍走各自独立的路线。
updates.detailed_summary_en:
OpenAI is rolling out a new 'Intelligent UI' in ChatGPT that lets the assistant combine a text answer with interactive diagrams, charts, forms and tappable buttons. The feature is being released alongside GPT-6 and is described as reaching all users.

The change alters how ChatGPT renders its answers across the platform, moving the assistant from plain text toward task-specific interactive output rather than only describing steps in prose.

According to OpenAI's announcement, GPT-6 with Intelligent UI began rolling out globally to ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise tiers in the Chat tab, with Free and Go tiers following the next day; the update applies to the ChatGPT chat experience, while Work and Codex remain on separate tracks.
updates.background_zh: GPT-6是OpenAI在GPT-5系列之后推出的新一代主力模型。“智能界面”这一思路延续了生成式界面（generative UI）的概念，即由模型根据提示或上下文生成界面元素，而不仅仅是文字。
updates.background_en: GPT-6 is OpenAI's next major model in the GPT series, following the GPT-5 family. The 'Intelligent UI' concept extends the idea of generative UI, in which a model generates interface elements — not just text — in response to a prompt or context.
updates.market_impact_zh: ChatGPT是消费级AI的重要分发渠道，因此其平台层面转向可交互、可渲染的回答形式，主要通过情绪面对加密市场中的AI叙事板块产生关联，而非源于任何已公布的加密集成。现有材料中未提及直接的托管、流动性或链上关联。
updates.market_impact_en: ChatGPT is a major distribution channel for consumer AI, so a platform-wide shift toward interactive, rendered answers touches the AI-narrative segment of crypto markets mainly through sentiment rather than any announced crypto integration. No direct custody, liquidity or on-chain linkage is described in the available material.

updates.title_zh: OpenAI 28天冲刺Day 3：GPT-6进Chat，付费用户再送一次额度重置
updates.title_en: OpenAI 28天冲刺Day 3：GPT-6进Chat，付费用户再送一次额度重置
updates.what_changed_zh: 在OpenAI为期28天的产品冲刺第3天，GPT-6率先在ChatGPT聊天界面中面向Plus、Pro、Business和Enterprise用户推出（Free和Go用户随后跟进），同时还有消息称Codex与ChatGPT Work合计活跃用户达到4000万，且所有付费账户将获得一次性存储用量重置，有效期为一个月。
updates.what_changed_en: On Day 3 of OpenAI's 28-day product sprint, GPT-6 launched inside the ChatGPT chat interface first for Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise users (Free and Go to follow), alongside news that Codex and ChatGPT Work together hit 40 million active users and that all paid accounts will receive a one-time banked usage reset valid for a month.

updates.title_zh: 【OpenAI 推出 GPT-6 与 Intelligent UI，可在对话中生成交互式工具】
updates.title_en: 【OpenAI 推出 GPT-6 与 Intelligent UI，可在对话中生成交互式工具】
updates.what_changed_zh: OpenAI全球发布GPT-6和Intelligent UI，面向所有ChatGPT用户，让模型融合文本、视觉内容和交互元素，并生成游戏、交互式预算计算器等对话内工具。
updates.what_changed_en: OpenAI globally launched GPT-6 and Intelligent UI for all ChatGPT users, letting the model blend text, visual content, and interactive elements and generate in-conversation tools such as games and interactive budget calculators.

updates.title_zh: OpenAI 28天冲刺Day4：Sol超快档最高8倍速，Codex支持实时纠偏
updates.title_en: OpenAI 28天冲刺Day4：Sol超快档最高8倍速，Codex支持实时纠偏
updates.what_changed_zh: OpenAI 在 28 天产品冲刺第 4 天推出 GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast，向 API、Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 推送，Codex 中生成速度最高达标准模式的 8 倍，API 价格为标准档的 6 倍；同时改进 Codex 中途纠偏功能，允许用户在 Agent 执行任务时补充要求或纠正方向。
updates.what_changed_en: On Day 4 of OpenAI's 28-day product sprint, OpenAI rolled out GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast to API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work, with up to 8x faster generation in Codex and API pricing at 6x standard; it also improved Codex mid-task redirect, letting users add requests or correct direction while the agent is executing.
updates.current_state_zh: OpenAI 在 28 天产品冲刺第 4 天将 GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast 推向 API、Codex 和 ChatGPT Work，Codex 生成速度最高达标准模式 8 倍，API 定价为标准档 6 倍；Codex 还新增任务执行中途实时纠偏能力。
updates.current_state_en: On Day 4 of OpenAI's 28-day product sprint, OpenAI rolled out GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast to API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work, with up to 8x faster generation in Codex and API pricing at 6x standard; Codex also gained real-time mid-task redirect capability.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: OpenAI rolled out GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast to its API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work with up to 8x faster generation in Codex at 6x standard token pricing, alongside a new Codex feature letting users redirect agent tasks mid-execution.
updates.detailed_summary_en: OpenAI rolled out GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast to its API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work with up to 8x faster generation in Codex at 6x standard token pricing, alongside a new Codex feature letting users redirect agent tasks mid-execution.

updates.title_zh: OpenAI 28天产品冲刺Day16：Codex和Work缓存永久保留，API延长至12小时
updates.title_en: OpenAI 28天产品冲刺Day16：Codex和Work缓存永久保留，API延长至12小时
updates.what_changed_zh: OpenAI第16天冲刺更新使已登录的Codex和ChatGPT Work会话的提示缓存永久生效，并将Responses API缓存有效期从30分钟延长至12小时，写入成本为2.5倍，后续缓存命中可享大幅折扣。
updates.what_changed_en: OpenAI's Day 16 sprint update makes prompt caching permanent for logged-in Codex and ChatGPT Work sessions and extends Responses API cache lifetime from 30 minutes to 12 hours, at 2.5x write cost with steep discounts on subsequent cache hits.

updates.title_zh: OpenAI 28天产品冲刺Day18：连发多项更新，最后还是又送了一次Reset
updates.title_en: OpenAI 28天产品冲刺Day18：连发多项更新，最后还是又送了一次Reset
updates.what_changed_zh: OpenAI 第 18 天产品冲刺将 Decisions API 正式发布为 GA，把 Open Responses 跨模型 API 规范捐赠给 Linux 基金会的 Agentic AI 基金会，新增性能优化，Uber 将 ChatGPT Work 从 1000 人试点扩展至超过 30000 名员工，同时再次重置了速率限制。
updates.what_changed_en: OpenAI's Day 18 product sprint shipped the Decisions API as GA, donated the Open Responses cross-model API specification to the Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation, added performance optimizations, and saw Uber expand ChatGPT Work from a 1,000-person pilot to over 30,000 employees, alongside another rate-limit reset.
